note: A 2018 World Bank appraisal of a safety-net project (the capture is an excerpt, cut off in the economic analysis): civil registration appears only as one of the social services, with civil registry offices, that cash-transfer accompanying measures encourage parents to use where they exist. The systems it describes are the safety-net delivery MIS and the Unified Social Registry, which are social-protection systems outside the study's classes; no civil registration system is named.
